title: Test case 9 — Aggravated home invasion at night (Category 1; the 3-year minimum non-parole period)
shows: A statutory minimum with the Manual's own uncertainty about it: aggravated home invasion is a Category 1 offence with a mandatory minimum non-parole period of 3 years, unless a special reason is found; the Manual gives two different provisions for the minimum and says it “might” be satisfied by an overall non-parole period on several charges, and the app shows both as cautions with their flags rather than resolving them. A late plea and relevant priors.
